lines.speaker: MAYA_01
lines.text: AI is moving past the chat box. Companies are starting to give agents access to money, software, and physical systems.

lines.speaker: AXEL_01
lines.text: And once software can actually do things, the biggest question changes. It is not only how smart the model is. It is who gave it permission.

lines.speaker: MAYA_01
lines.text: That becomes a money problem fast. Imagine an agent that can approve vendors, initiate payments, or move inventory without a clean chain of authority.

lines.speaker: AXEL_01
lines.text: Now put the same idea inside a factory. A robot does not care whether a command came from a brilliant model. The machine only sees a command.

lines.speaker: MAYA_01
lines.text: So the infrastructure race may not be about building another model. It may be about building the layer that decides which models are actually allowed to act.

lines.speaker: AXEL_01
lines.text: That is the frontier we are watching here: intelligence, authority, and what happens when software finally reaches the real world.
